hooks.name: research-assistant-start
hooks.description: Ask for the paper source, notes path, and study goals before research work.

action.prompt: You are starting a research_assistant session. Before doing paper work, ask for the paper URL, DOI, arXiv URL, or readable local source; the repository-relative Markdown notes path; optional study goals, allowing multiple selections; and the first priority. Do not guess a path or silently change the active paper.

hooks.name: research-assistant-prompt
hooks.description: Require source-aware work and one concise Q&A note for every user prompt.

action.prompt: After answering this user request, read the active paper workspace and append exactly one concise, chronological Q&A entry to the confirmed primary notes file before finalizing. Preserve existing content. Update paper or knowledge indexes only when relevant or requested, link entries to source paper files, and report write failures honestly. If the paper source or notes path is not confirmed, ask for them first.

hooks.name: research-assistant-stop
hooks.description: Check that the completed interaction was captured.

action.prompt: Before ending this turn, verify that the current interaction was captured in the confirmed primary notes file as one concise Q&A entry. If not, append it now; do not claim it was saved if writing failed.
